result.title: Editable Video Context: Mid-Context KV-Cache Reuse for Context-Managing Video LLMs
result.summary: Context Language Models let a model edit its own context, while Suffix Cache Reuse makes edits to text efficient by adjusting the positions of cached keys for surviving tokens. We extend these ideas to video language models with multimodal rotary position embeddings (M-RoPE). We represent a long video as timestamped segments. After viewing a sparsely sampled version, the model selects segments for decoding at 4x the frame rate, and the remaining segments are removed from its context. Our rebuild method reuses the KV cache of surviving segments by rotating their keys with a single offset shared by the temporal, height, and width components of Qwen2.5-VL's M-RoPE. A content-hashed cache also avoids repeating vision-encoder computation for those segments. In preliminary experiments with Qwen2.5-VL-7B on synthetic needle-in-a-video-haystack questions over public-domain films, the method reduces prefill tokens and end-to-end rebuild latency relative to full recomputation while usually producing the same answer. Densifying the segment containing the answer improves accuracy when that segment is known. When the model selects segments itself, accuracy does not improve: it rarely identifies a needle that was absent from the sparse sample. We release the code, raw logs, and scripts used to reproduce the paper's results.

AI.brief_summary: 提出「可编辑视频上下文」：长视频按时间戳分段，模型在稀疏采样后自选片段以 4 倍帧率解码并删除其余段；通过给 M-RoPE 时/高/宽分量加同一偏移来旋转复用幸存段的 KV cache，并用内容哈希缓存避免重复视觉编码。
AI.relevance_reason: 直接关联视觉证据筛选与「LOOK」的收益/成本：实验显示模型自选片段不能提升准确率、稀疏采样中缺失的针难以被找回，可供核查主动观看能否补足证据；其 KV cache 偏移复用也可能提示推理期状态复用的代价问题。
